title: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 5.0.0 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Certificate Validation…
description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules versions 5.0.0 through 10.0.3 contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the iDRACConnection component. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to potentially cause information exposure and unauthorized access. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.7. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
